R2_shadow.action: the sleeve moves to SHADOW_FORWARD_ONLY in a new versioned lock, without any retuning

R0_alert.measure: sum of the last 126 sessions of daily net PnL
R0_alert.trigger: below the registered threshold (minimum of the same sum over the frozen history)

R3_alert.measure: sum of the last 120 sessions of daily net PnL
R3_alert.trigger: below the p5 of the bootstrap 120-session PnL

rules.review_exit: a sleeve leaves ACTIVE_UNDER_REVIEW when neither R0 nor R3 has fired over the last 120 sessions
rules.reinstatement: only by a new versioned decision after at least 252 sessions in shadow, if the shadow cumulative PnL never fell below its p5(h) and is >= 0 at 252 (audit_20261115/05_regles_arret.md)
